item.title: Carnell Tate: Expected to play Sunday
item.description:
Tate (shoulder) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Cowboys but is "considered likely" to be cleared to play, Matt Zenitz of CBS Sports reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Rachaad White: Not spotted at Saturday's practice
item.description:
White (heel) was not on the field during the opening portion of Saturday's practice session, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Baker Mayfield: Working through plantar fascia injury
item.description:
Mayfield (thumb) is dealing with a plantar fascia injury in his foot, and he would wear a special orthotic and new cleats to stabilize his foot if he's cleared to play against the Lions on Sunday, Tom Pelissero of The Ringer and Netflix reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Davante Adams: Not in line to be ready following bye
item.description:
With regard to the availability of Adams (hamstring) -- who remains on IR -- head coach Sean McVay said Friday "we'll take it a week at a time" with the wideout, while adding that he doesn't "think he's ready quite yet," Zach Edwards of the Rams' official site reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: D'Andre Swift: Welcoming back Monangai
item.description:
Swift will be rejoined in the Bears backfield by Kyle Monangai (toe) on Sunday against the Saints, Larry Mayer of the team's official site reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
